prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Save & Sync Your Desktop Pet", "Your pet customization and progress will automatically back up to your account.", "Cloud Save & Sync Active", "Continue with Saved Account"]
1: ["Preview Your Custom Pet", "Check how your pet looks before completing the official adoption certificate.", "Looks Great, Adopt!"]
2: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion!", "Practice interacting with your pet right here before launching onto your full desktop view.", "Tip: Right-click your pet anywhere on screen for quick controls."]
3: ["Save Your Path Preference", "Create your account now to sync your chosen pet companion settings across desktop devices."]
4: ["Initializing Desktop Pet Environment...", "Your pet is getting ready to appear on your desktop.", "If your pet window is hidden, look for the companion icon in your system tray."]
5: ["Choose Your Companion Creation Method", "Pick an instant premade friend or create a custom pet rendered from your photos.", "Don't worry—you can adopt additional pets anytime later."]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Complete adoption to unlock your official certificate and 100 bonus starter treats!", "+100 Bonus Starter Treats Included"]
7: ["We'll notify your system tray as soon as your pet is active on screen."]
8: ["Pick Your Ideal Companion", "Select a pet to view its personality traits and live desktop behavior."]
9: ["Your Pet is Active on Desktop!", "Drag your pet anywhere on your screen. Double-click to open quick actions.", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P to hide or show your pet instantly."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or bonus gifts
